claude.sample_unit: patients (855 colposcopic images from WHO open-source dataset), read by 45 colposcopists

links.outcome: Colposcopist CIN2+ sensitivity with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: With AI assistance, colposcopists sensitivity increased from 84.8% (95% CI, 82.7–86.9%) to 90.6% (95% CI, 88.7–92.1%); low-experience readers' AUC rose from 0.72 to 0.76 (p = 0.043).
links.quote: With AI assistance, colposcopists sensitivity increased from 84.8% (95% CI, 82.7–86.9%) to 90.6% (95% CI, 88.7–92.1%).

links.outcome: AI performance on independent external WHO dataset versus internal testing
links.effect: Validated on independent WHO open-source set of 187 patients; standalone CIN2+ sensitivity 84.2% (95%CI 74.4–90.7%), described as robust performance on an external dataset.
links.quote: internal testing of the AI model could overestimate diagnostic performance

unlisted_practices: AI-guided biopsy site selection to reduce biopsies per case (2.48 to 2.02)
